openstack_region.description: Comma-separated regions to scan; defaults to every region in the service catalog

openstack_application_credential_id.description: Application credential ID; takes precedence over password authentication

openstack_project_id.description: Project ID, for password authentication; this or openstack_project_name is required

openstack_project_name.description: Project name, for password authentication; ignored if openstack_project_id is set

openstack_domain_name.description: Domain of the user, and of the project when given by name, for password authentication

allOf.$comment: An application credential needs both its ID and its secret.
Authenticate with an application credential, or with a username and password.
Password authentication must name the project to scope the token to.
